title: Thai Steak Salad New
description: Lots of veggies and herbs pack flavorful Thai Steak Salad. It's quick to prepare and would also be delicious with grilled chicken or lamb.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon Sriracha (hot chile sauce, such as Huy Fong)
directions: Heat a large grill pan over medium-high heat. Coat pan with cooking spray. Sprinkle steak evenly with pepper and salt. Add steak to pan; cook 6 minutes each side or until desired degree of doneness. Remove steak from pan; let stand 5 minutes. Cut steak diagonally across grain into thin slices.
Combine juice and next 5 ingredients (through Sriracha) in a small bowl; stir with a whisk.

Combine cabbage and remaining ingredients in a medium bowl. Add 6 tablespoons juice mixture to cabbage mixture; toss well. Toss steak in remaining 2 tablespoons juice mixture. Add steak to cabbage mixture; toss to combine.
